_note: Each axis is sampled independently. Add, remove or rewrite options freely — richer lists mean more variety. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the sampler.

density: ultra-minimal: 3-4 sections, ONE typeface family, one accent used at most 3 times, no animated signature (the signature is typographic or a single static mark)
minimal: 4-5 sections, two typefaces, one accent, one quiet signature element, motion only on interaction
balanced: 5-7 sections, one signature graphic, restrained motion
maximal: 7+ sections, layered signature graphic, rich motion and texture
ground: a saturated color field as the page background
page_structure: manifesto: one strong statement, one proof row, one call to action
index-first: the page IS a list/table of the real content (e.g. live listings) with a short intro above
two doors: split immediately into the two audiences, each with its own short path
question-led: the headline is a question, each section answers part of it
classic: hero, value, how it works, proof, FAQ, call to action
search-first: the search/filter bar is the hero
movement: dark editorial poster (Swiss grid meets gig poster)
neo-brutalist web (hard shadows, raw borders, loud blocks)
risograph zine (overprint, misregistration, two spot inks)
Japanese minimal print (vast whitespace, tiny type, one red mark)
Bauhaus geometry (primary shapes, strict modular composition)
70s psychedelic print (warm saturated waves, groovy display type)
Y2K chrome and gloss (liquid metal, bevels, techno type)
terminal / CRT interface (phosphor glow, scanlines, mono everything)
luxury fashion magazine (high-contrast serif, huge margins, cream paper)
museum wayfinding signage (pictograms, numbered zones, color codes)
scientific journal / technical manual (figures, captions, footnotes)
90s rave flyer (stretched type, acid colors, sticker chaos)
architectural blueprint (cyan lines, dimension marks, drafting labels)
sports broadcast graphics (scoreboards, tickers, italic condensed type)
letterpress stationery (deboss feel, ink spread, warm paper)
Soviet constructivist poster (diagonals, red and black, photomontage blocks)
palette_strategy: one acid accent on near-black, everything else greyscale
warm off-white paper + black ink + ONE spot color
duotone: two inks only, overlaps create a third
full-saturation clash of three brights on white
monochrome in a single hue across 7 tints and shades
deep jewel tones on dark (emerald, oxblood, ink blue)
sun-faded print: muted pastels with one dark anchor
phosphor: one glowing color on pure black
earth tones: clay, olive, sand, charcoal
safety colors: hazard orange, signal yellow, black
type_strategy: giant heavy wide display in ALL CAPS + neutral grotesk body + mono labels
high-contrast didone serif display, italic accents + clean sans body
ultra-condensed display stacked tall + humanist sans body
a single typeface family used at extreme weight/size contrast
mono everywhere, hierarchy only from size and inverse blocks
soft rounded display + friendly geometric body
expressive serif headlines set tight + small caps labels
techno / squared display + wide letter-spaced labels
signature_graphic: pixel-grid gradient panels on <canvas>, quantized cells, slow noise drift
halftone dot field that reacts to the cursor
ASCII-art rendering of a shape, characters shimmering
giant outlined type that fills with color on scroll
marquee ribbons crossing the page at angles
generative contour/topographic lines, slowly morphing
stacked index cards / tickets with perforated edges
oversized numbers as graphic elements (01, 02, 03) cropped by the viewport
dithered (1-bit Bayer) images and gradients
rotating 3D text ring built with CSS transforms
grain + misregistered color offset on every block
data-like bar/sparkline motifs used as decoration
cut-paper shapes with hard drop shadows
a single blob/gooey shape that morphs between sections
layout_archetype: asymmetric split hero: giant headline left, tall poster card right
12-column magazine spread with pull quotes and captions
one enormous headline per screen, slow vertical narrative
bento grid of deliberately unequal tiles
left fixed index column, content scrolls on the right
centered single column like a printed letter, wide margins
dashboard / control panel with modules and readouts
motion_personality: slow and calm: long eases, nothing faster than 600ms
glitchy: brief offsets, RGB split on hover
almost none — print-like; only focus and hover states
scroll-driven: elements reveal and scale with scroll position
typographic: letters roll, split, and re-assemble
wildcard_rule: every number on the page is set in tabular mono
the accent color appears at most 5 times on the whole page
every section has a numbered index label
all images replaced by generative graphics — zero photos
headline sizes jump dramatically: nothing between 24px and 96px
buttons are plain underlined text, no filled buttons except one
content is annotated like a diagram with leader lines
the footer is the most dramatic part of the page
